verdict.rationale: The evidence only glancingly shows built-in AI: one mention of a 'Canva AI' that users can feed pasted links to design with more context. The design-generation and natural-language editing capabilities are documented through the MCP server for external AI assistants, not as in-editor tools for a designer. missing for 10: evidence of in-editor image generation, background removal, content-aware fill, copy/text suggestions, first-party product docs for these AI editor features, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
